A.claim: Beal Prize status (verified 2026-09-17): US $1,000,000 held by the AMS, donated by D. Andrew Beal, announced in the Notices of the AMS December 1997; awarded for EITHER a proof OR a counterexample, conditional on publication in a refereed and respected mathematics publication, a two-year waiting period, and verification by two outside experts chose

B.claim: No Beal counterexample of signature (2m,2n,3) with m>=4 and n>=4. Even m or even n: signature (4,2n,3) / (2m,4,3), excluded by BCDY 2015 Thm 1. Both odd (>=5): C odd forces a+bi=(u+vi)^3 in Z[i]; on whichever side 3 does not divide the parameter, (s^2)^m+(-eps t)^m=3v^2 with m odd, forbidden by Bennett-Skinner 2004 Thm 1.1 (C=3).
